title: Licensed Security Rostered for a Cancelled Date
content:
Licensed security rostered for the date of a Private Event & Banquet Services event is charged on top where it can no longer be stood down.

## The rule

1. Where written notice was given inside seven days of the event and the count standing in the cancellation entry passes the security threshold printed against the package, the security rate per hour printed against the package is charged for the service hours included in the same package.
2. Where written notice was given at or beyond seven days before the event but inside the days deposits stay returnable printed against the package, and the count standing in the cancellation entry passes the security threshold printed against the package, the security rate per hour printed against the package is charged for the set-up lead hours printed against the same package.
3. Where neither holds, no security stands on the charge.

A count standing exactly at the security threshold does not pass it, so nothing stands on the charge on that count.

## The figures each package prints

| Package | Security threshold, guests | Security rate, USD per hour | Service hours included | Set-up lead hours | Inside seven days, USD | At or beyond seven days and inside the returnable window, USD |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 0 | 0 | 0.0 | 0.5 | 0 | 0 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 0 | 0 | 2.0 | 1.0 | 0 | 0 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 150 | 46 | 4.0 | 2.0 | 184 | 92 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 250 | 52 | 5.0 | 4.0 | 260 | 208 |
| Gala Reception Package | 400 | 58 | 6.0 | 6.0 | 348 | 348 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 500 | 55 | 10.0 | 8.0 | 550 | 440 |

## The days deposits stay returnable

| Package | Deposits returnable until, calendar days before the event |
| --- | --- |
| Meeting Room Refreshment Package | 2 |
| Boardroom Reception Package | 7 |
| Conference Day Delegate Package | 21 |
| Seated Banquet Package | 45 |
| Gala Reception Package | 90 |
| Multi-Day Conference Residency Package | 120 |

## Illustration on hypothetical records

A cancellation entry on the Gala Reception Package stands at 520 guests with written notice given 30 days before the event. The notice is at or beyond seven days and inside the 90 days deposits stay returnable, and 520 passes the threshold of 400, so 58 for each hour over the 6.0 set-up lead hours stands on the charge, that is 348. Had notice been given 4 days before the event, 58 over the 6.0 service hours included would stand, again 348; and at 95 days before the event nothing would stand on that account.
